manual_playtest_checklist: Open HideoutHub.tscn.
Buy or use already-owned Taco Bell Stool.
Open Open Decor Area.
Select item.
Click Enter Click-to-Place Mode.
Confirm panel closes.
Confirm HUD has readable text.
Confirm HUD has Exit Decorating Mode button.
Confirm HUD has Cancel Placement button when carrying.
Confirm HUD has Remove Selected button when item selected.
Confirm HUD lists available owned unplaced item(s).
Confirm grid appears.
Move mouse around open floor.
Confirm preview follows mouse smoothly and only snaps to grid.
Move mouse over/near Mission Board, The Big Case, Polaroid Wall, Glow Guy Shelf, and other no-place zones.
Confirm preview does NOT fly around in weird rows/columns.
Confirm preview simply stays under snapped mouse position and turns red/blocked over invalid areas.
Left-click on valid open floor.
Confirm item places.
Confirm still in Decorating Mode.
Click placed item.
Confirm item becomes selected/movable.
Move mouse.
Confirm selected item follows mouse as preview.
Left-click to place it somewhere else.
Confirm item moved, not duplicated.
Try placing on invalid red spot.
Confirm nearest-open search only happens when clicking, not while hovering.
Confirm invalid click either snaps to nearby valid spot or says no open spot nearby.
Press R or Delete with item selected.
Confirm item disappears and remains owned.
Use HUD item picker to select it again.
Place it again.
Right-click while carrying and confirm cancel.
Press Esc while carrying and confirm cancel.
Press Esc while idle and confirm Decorating Mode exits.
Enter Decorating Mode again and press HUD Exit Decorating Mode.
Confirm Decorating Mode exits.
Confirm E interactions work afterward.
Confirm Store, Loot Crate, Open Decor, Planning Table, and Mission Board still open.
Confirm MissionBoard still launches Taco Bell.
Confirm pause exit still returns to HideoutHub.
Confirm no Taco Bell scenes were modified.
